page.layout: One column of running text, with a short numbered list. One marginal note in the left margin, beside the line "dri.1.Tim.1." No right margin text, no footnotes.

main_text.p: 3. Quæ sit occupatio obiectionis de promis-sione conditionali nisi deficeret: quia lapsuum pœnam Deus ei minatur non abiectionem sed castigationem. Pf.89.31.
Inferatur ex consequenti antecedens: Ergo etiam promisit nunquam ita lapsurum, ut peni-tus abiiciendus esset.
4. Ex Solomonis precatione pro gratia per-severantiæ. 1. Reg. 8.57. &c. quæ haud dubie est exaudita. 1.Reg.9.3.
5. Quia totalis eius defectio à fide & cultu Dei non afstruitur in historia: quod ostendatur ex textu. 1.Reg.11.v.4.6. Cor eius non fuit perfectum sicut, &c. Non ergo penitus defecit, &c.
Amplificetur collatione phraseos huius cum aliis, quibus totalis defectio & impietas notatur.
Item: ex causis impulsivis: Peccavit in senectute amore uxorum, &c. Non ergo malitia aut odio Dei, sed infirmitate, &c.
6. Quia Scriptura habet argumenta non ob-scura eius resipiscentiæ.
1. quod Roboam dicitur ambulasse triennio in via Davidis & Solomonis.2.Par.11.17.
2. quod Ecclesiastes, de communi Hebræorum sententia, est Solomonis senis publica errorum παλινῳδία [?], peccatorum confessio, detestatio, & pœnitentia: cap.2.v.11.17.18.
v. Simonis magi. Act.8. Hymenæi, & Alexan-3.Dec.93.dri.1.Tim.1. Phigelli & Hermogenis.2.Tim.1.15. Phileti. 2.Tim.2.17.

page.notes: The marginal note "3.Dec.93." is a printed reference in the left margin, beside the line "dri.1.Tim.1." The word "afstruitur" is uncertain; the scan shows a doubled f-type letter and could be "astruitur". The Greek word "παλινῳδία" is read from a worn line and is uncertain. The catchword "proin-" is taken as printed, with its hyphen. The "Amplificetur" line opens with a small decorative mark before it, which is not transcribed.
